{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Identify sentinel values
sentinel_mask = df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999.0

# Compute response rates in the full population (including sentinel values)
control_response_rate_full = df[df['arm'] == 'control']['responded'].mean()
treatment_response_rate_full = df[df['arm'] == 'treatment']['responded'].mean()
treatment_effect_full = treatment_response_rate_full - control_response_rate_full

# Print the computed values
print(f"Control response rate (full population): {control_response_rate_full}")
print(f"Treatment response rate (full population): {treatment_response_rate_full}")
print(f"Treatment effect (treatment minus control): {treatment_effect_full}")

# Return the values
control_response_rate_full, treatment_response_rate_full, treatment_effect_full"}
